## Summary

- Describe the formatter, docs, or tooling change.

## GitFlow Check

- `feature/*` PRs target `develop`.
- `release/*` and `hotfix/*` PRs target `main`.
- Release and hotfix work will be back-merged into `develop`.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm run release:check` when preparing a release or hotfix
